finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:

- `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when a flag came back `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled, same as `false`.

The rest was harmless deprecation spam (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) — left as-is since those aren't breaking anything.
